description: The applications the candidate tracks on TrueInterview, most recently updated first, a page at a time, with a count for every status over the whole tracker (zeros included). Each row's status is the same word the status filter, track_application and update_application take (an interview carries interview_round). page.has_more says another page follows and page.total how many rows the filter covers. prepare_application already says whether a role is tracked, across every row. Each row's prep counts that employer's reported questions and interview notes.
name: list_applications
title: List my applications
